# pve_ha_status (Data Source)

HA cluster status: manager status, current resource states, and index.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ha_status" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `current` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/ha/status/current. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current))
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `index` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/ha. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--index))
- `manager_status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manager_status))
- `status` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/ha/status (the API schema does not describe its shape).

<a id="nestedatt--current"></a>
### Nested Schema for `current`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) Status entry ID (quorum, master, lrm:<node>, service:<sid>).
- `armed_state` (String) For type 'fencing'. Whether HA is armed, on standby, disarming or disarmed.
- `auto_rebalance` (Boolean) HA resource may be migrated during automatic rebalancing.
- `crm_state` (String) For type 'service'. Service state as seen by the CRM.
- `failback` (Boolean) The HA resource is automatically migrated to the node with the highest priority according to their node affinity rule, if a node with a higher priority than the current node comes online.
- `max_relocate` (Number) For type 'service'.
- `max_restart` (Number) For type 'service'.
- `node` (String) Node associated to status entry.
- `quorate` (Boolean) For type 'quorum'. Whether the cluster is quorate or not.
- `request_state` (String) For type 'service'. Requested service state.
- `resource_mode` (String) For type 'fencing'. How resources are handled while disarmed.
- `sid` (String) For type 'service'. Service ID.
- `state` (String) For type 'service'. Verbose service state.
- `status` (String) Status of the entry (value depends on type).
- `timestamp` (Number) For type 'lrm','master'. Timestamp of the status information.
- `type` (String) Type of status entry.

Read-Only:
